text:
Lena P: quick check on the trace viewer UI—when you open a request drilldown the stacktrace teaser is pushing other header controls down on narrower widths. We need a compact pattern.
Diego R: could we move the first stack frame into a collapsible 'top frame' inline pill (single-line) that expands into full stack on click? That would keep header height stable.
Maya H: love that. Accessibility: the pill should have aria-expanded and a visible focus ring. When expanded, focus should move to the first stack frame and pressing Escape should collapse it.
Lena P: also correlation ids—people want copy + permalink. Suggest 'Corr ID · copy · open' small inline actions under an overflow to avoid crowding.
Diego R: small UX trade: hiding copy behind overflow adds friction for frequent copy users. Maybe show copy icon and put 'open' behind overflow. Or show copy on hover for desktop.
Maya H: keyboard needs explicit copy target. Make copy action a button with aria-label 'Copy correlation id to clipboard'. Tooltip on copy shows 'Copied!' and is announced for screen readers via aria-live='polite'.
Lena P: about export: rename the modal header to 'Export trace data' and include a simple 1-line stub 'Choose format and time window. Streaming sends live events to the console.' Primary CTA 'Download JSON' and a secondary 'Stream to console'.
Diego R: add size estimate under download: 'Estimated: 95KB (last 1m)'. If the window is large show warning 'Large export may take up to 3 minutes'.
Maya H: stream affordance: when streaming, show a small '● streaming' chip with aria-live updates for count. Provide keyboard shortcut to toggle stream (Ctrl+Shift+S) and include it in the tooltip.
UXBot: preview build: https://preview.redwood/trace-ui/1758801 — note uses synthetic data.
Lena P: last visual nit: separator between status chip and error pill is too thin on dark mode. Use more contrast or a vertical divider.
Diego R: I'll mock up the collapsed top-frame vs inline expand and post a gif. If we like it we can add to the components page.
Maya H: I'll write the a11y test steps for the PR: tab order, aria-expanded, aria-live streaming, tooltip announcements, escape to close.
Lena P: thanks team — will iterate figma and attach screens here when ready. :sparkles:
